title: Marvel (MCU) Essentials
description: Avengers, origin films, characters everyone knows.

questions.prompt: What is Iron Man's real name?
What was the first MCU film?
questions.explanation: Released May 2, 2008 and directed by Jon Favreau, Iron Man launched the Marvel Cinematic Universe and Phase One.

questions.prompt: Who played Captain America in the Infinity Saga?
questions.explanation: Evans first played Steve Rogers in Captain America: The First Avenger (2011) and passed the shield to Sam Wilson at the end of Endgame.

questions.prompt: What is Thor's hammer called?
questions.explanation: Forged in the heart of a dying star, Mjolnir can only be lifted by those deemed worthy; Hela shatters it in Thor: Ragnarok (2017).

questions.prompt: What is Captain America's real name?
Who played Tony Stark in the MCU?
questions.explanation: Downey's casting in 2008 was considered a gamble given his past; the role revived his career and anchored the MCU for over a decade.

questions.prompt: What is Star-Lord's real name in Guardians of the Galaxy?
questions.explanation: Played by Chris Pratt, Quill is half-human, half-Celestial; he was abducted from Earth in 1988 after his mother's death.

questions.prompt: What planet was Thanos from?
questions.explanation: Titan is a moon of Saturn in Marvel lore, devastated by overpopulation — the trauma that drove Thanos's culling philosophy.

questions.prompt: Who is Thor's adopted brother?
questions.explanation: Played by Tom Hiddleston, Loki is a Frost Giant adopted by Odin; he's the god of mischief and the villain of the first Avengers film.

questions.prompt: What is the Hulk's real name?
What fictional country is Black Panther king of?
questions.explanation: Wakanda is an isolated East African nation made wealthy by vibranium deposits from an ancient meteorite strike.

questions.prompt: Who played T'Challa / Black Panther?
questions.explanation: Boseman debuted as T'Challa in Captain America: Civil War (2016); the role was not recast after his death in 2020.

questions.prompt: What is Black Widow's real name?
questions.explanation: Played by Scarlett Johansson, Natasha is a former KGB assassin trained in the Red Room; she sacrifices herself on Vormir in Endgame.

questions.prompt: Who directed Avengers: Infinity War and Endgame?
questions.explanation: Anthony and Joe Russo also directed Captain America: The Winter Soldier and Civil War; Endgame (2019) became one of the highest-grossing films ever.

questions.prompt: How many Infinity Stones are there?
questions.explanation: Space, Mind, Reality, Power, Time, and Soul — six singularities from before the universe, each controlling a fundamental aspect of existence.

questions.prompt: Who is Spider-Man's mentor in the MCU?
questions.explanation: Stark recruits Peter for Civil War and gifts him the upgraded suit; Peter's grief over Tony's death drives Far From Home (2019).

questions.prompt: Who plays Spider-Man in the MCU?
questions.explanation: Holland debuted as Peter Parker in Captain America: Civil War (2016), the third live-action Spider-Man after Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield.

questions.prompt: What is Doctor Strange's first name?
questions.explanation: Dr. Stephen Strange was a brilliant neurosurgeon until a car crash ruined his hands; he's played by Benedict Cumberbatch.

questions.prompt: What organization does Nick Fury lead?
questions.explanation: Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division — the spy agency that assembles the Avengers and is later infiltrated by Hydra.

questions.prompt: Who played Nick Fury in the MCU?
questions.explanation: Jackson first appeared in the post-credits scene of Iron Man (2008), establishing the Avengers Initiative and the wider MCU.

questions.prompt: What color is the Hulk?
Who is Tony Stark's longtime love interest and assistant?
questions.explanation: Played by Gwyneth Paltrow, Pepper marries Tony and dons the Rescue armor during the final battle in Avengers: Endgame.

questions.prompt: What is Captain America's shield primarily made of?
questions.explanation: The shield was forged by Howard Stark from rare Wakandan vibranium, the same metal that powers Wakanda and protects T'Challa's suit.

questions.prompt: What Disney+ series follows the wizarding couple in a sitcom-style town?
questions.explanation: The 2021 series follows Wanda Maximoff and Vision through pastiches of classic sitcoms, set in the New Jersey town of Westview.

questions.prompt: Who snaps half of all life away at the end of Infinity War?
questions.explanation: Wielding the completed Infinity Gauntlet, Thanos executes 'the Snap' on Wakanda's battlefield in the 2018 film, erasing half of all life.
